messages:
talia: quick postmortem follow-up: we keep hitting a recurring pattern where transient DNS resolver failures lead to immediate LB host-blacklist and rapid cross-region failover, which then causes TLS SNI mismatches on fallback. want owners + short timelines.
marc: saw it in traces at 13:14 UTC — lots of short blacklists (~1-3s) followed by large spike in cross-region traffic.
evan: logs look like this:
```
2026-07-12T13:14:07Z dns.client: query=svc.prod.internal response=SERVFAIL
2026-07-12T13:14:07Z lb.edge: host_blacklist_add host=10.8.3.22 duration=2s reason=resolve_fail
2026-07-12T13:14:07Z lb.edge: route_fallback target_region=us-west-2 reason=degraded_primary
2026-07-12T13:14:07Z tls.cache: sni_mismatch host=10.8.3.22
```
sophia: hypothesis: blacklist threshold and DNS retry handling are too brittle for transient resolver errors; cert rotation timing amplifies it.
talia: propose these follow-ups (owners + ETA):
- F1: resolver wrapper: 2 fast in-process retries with 150ms jitter, then backoff before returning failure (owner: evan). ETA: PR in 48h, canary in 4d.
- F2: change blacklist policy to "probation" semantics: mark host probation for 10s on first failure instead of full blacklist; require repeated failures or handshake errors to escalate (owner: marc). ETA: design + PR in 5d.
- F3: add metric+alert for rapid DNS-resolve-rate + host-rotation spikes (owner: talia). ETA: dashboard + alert in 3d.
- F4: synthetic TLS probe that runs a post-rotate handshake check per-host; delay routing if probe fails (owner: ryan). ETA: prototype in 1 week.
evan: I'll take F1. Implementation note: keep wrapper in lb-agent, avoid touching system resolver, unit tests to simulate SERVFAIL->OK.
marc: F2 will need a short state machine; I'll draft transitions and memory bounds. will post doc in INC-4801.
talia: infra-bot: create ticket for follow-ups and link to postmortem
infra-bot: Created INC-4801: https://tracker.internal/INC-4801 - "edge: transient-resolver -> blacklist -> tls-fallback mitigations" assigned to triage\sophia: small follow-up: add an e2e chaos test to simulate resolver flapping + cert rotation and assert we don't flip for <10s. owner: sophia. ETA: 1 week.
talia: please update INC-4801 with PR links, runbook changes, and test plans. I'll run a 3-day sync on Friday to check progress. if anything blocks, tag eng-oncall. :thumbsup:
